test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct option to form a meaningful sentence.

I can't (a)/ to (b)/ see (c)/ of (d)/ dogs (e)/ rehomed (f)/ bear (g)/ pictures (h)/ rescued (i)/ waiting (j)/ to be (k)

options.text: a, k, b, h, d, i, j, g, f, c, e
a, j, b, c, d, i, e, k, g, f, h
a, b, h, i, e, j, k, f, g, c, d
a, g, b, c, h, d, i, e, j, k, f

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To form a meaningful sentence, the words need to be in the correct order to convey a logical and coherent message.
 
• The correct sequence is:** "I can't bear to see pictures of rescued dogs waiting to be rehomed."**
 
• Breaking it down: 
 
 
• a) I can't
 
• g) bear
 
• b) to
 
• c) see
 
• h) pictures
 
• d) of
 
• i) rescued
 
• e) dogs
 
• j) waiting
 
• k) to be
 
• f) rehomed
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1**: a, k, b, h, d, i, j, g, f, c, e - This sequence does not form a logical sentence order.
 
• Option 2: a, j, b, c, d, i, e, k, g, f, h - This sequence does not form a logical sentence order.
 
• **Option 3**: a, b, h, i, e, j, k, f, g, c, d - This sequence does not form a logical sentence order.
